title: Verify: Create round duration request unit tests
summary: Unit tests that duration is sent and 401 returns to the gate
description: Test createRound and the Create round button with mocked fetch.

steps.action: Create jsdom test file using the stubFetch pattern of tests/admin.test.tsx with roundFixture and worldFixture from tests/fixtures/api.ts (backend contract: createRoundRequest in backend/internal/admin/rounds.go). Test 1: enter token secret, change Duration (hours) to 12, click Create round, find the POST to /api/v1/admin/rounds, assert method POST, Bearer secret, JSON body equals {world_id:'the-boys-room', duration:'12h'}. Test 2: the create POST returns 401 json; assert the Admin token input is shown again.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminCreateRound.test.tsx
